description: This file defines classes and functions related to constraints used in tensor type inference and manipulation within the PyTorch FX framework, including various constraint classes, utility functions, and external dependencies.

classes.name: Constraint
classes.description: Base class for all constraint types.

classes.name: BinaryConstraint
classes.description: Represents all binary operations between constraints.

classes.name: TGreatestUpperBound
classes.description: Greatest upper bound for tensors with dynamic type.

classes.name: CanReshape
classes.description: Constraint indicating a tensor can be reshaped.

classes.name: IndexSelect
classes.description: Constraint for index select operation on tensors.

classes.name: GetItem
classes.description: Constraint for getting an item from a tensor by index.

classes.name: GetItemTensor
classes.description: Constraint for getting an item from a tensor with tuple indexing.

classes.name: CalcMaxPool
classes.description: Constraint representing a max pooling calculation.

classes.name: CalcProduct
classes.description: Constraint for calculating product of dimensions.

methods.name: is_algebraic_expression
methods.description: Checks if a constraint is an algebraic expression.

methods.name: is_bool_expr
methods.description: Checks if a constraint is a boolean expression.

methods.name: is_dim
methods.description: Checks if a variable is a dimension.
